req.title: Return POST request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to POST /post with JSON including url, args, headers, form, data, files, json and origin.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that POST /post returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, and origin. Tests are designed to: (1) verify the happy path with form data (EP), (2) verify JSON body payload reflection (EP+DT), (3) verify query-string args reflection (BVA), (4) verify wrong HTTP method returns 405 not 200 (NEG), (5) verify empty POST body still returns all required keys with correct types (BVA). Each test asserts exact status codes and exact key presence/values to kill constant-mutation, key-omission, and operator-flip mutants.

tests.name: test_post_form_data_returns_200_with_all_required_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: POST to /post with application/x-www-form-urlencoded body containing key=value
expected: Response JSON contains keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin
form field reflects submitted key-value pair exactly
data field is empty string for form submission
json field is null for form submission
trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: POST /post returns JSON including url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_form_data_returns_200_with_all_required_keys():
    r = client.post('/post', data={'mykey': 'myvalue'},
                    content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'):
        assert key in body, f'Missing key: {key}'
    assert body['form'] == {'mykey': 'myvalue'}
    assert body['data'] == ''
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert isinstance(body['args'], dict)
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    assert isinstance(body['files'], dict)

test_post_form_data_returns_200_with_all_required_keys()

tests.name: test_post_json_body_reflected_in_json_field
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: POST to /post with Content-Type application/json and JSON payload {"alpha": 1, "beta": true}
expected: Response body 'form' field is empty dict
Response body 'data' field contains the raw JSON string
trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: json field in response reflects parsed JSON body
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_json_body_reflected_in_json_field():
    payload = {'alpha': 1, 'beta': True}
    r = client.post('/post', data=json.dumps(payload),
                    content_type='application/json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'):
        assert key in body, f'Missing key: {key}'
    assert body['json'] == {'alpha': 1, 'beta': True}
    assert body['form'] == {}
    assert body['json']['alpha'] == 1
    assert body['json']['beta'] is True

test_post_json_body_reflected_in_json_field()

trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: args field reflects query string parameters
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_with_query_args_reflected_in_args_field():
    r = client.post('/post?foo=bar&baz=qux')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert body['args'] == {'foo': 'bar', 'baz': 'qux'}
    assert body['form'] == {}
    assert body['data'] == ''
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'foo=bar' in body['url'] or 'baz=qux' in body['url']

tests.name: test_post_empty_body_returns_all_keys_with_correct_types
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: POST to /post with completely empty body and no content-type
expected: All eight keys present: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin
trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: boundary — empty POST body still returns all required fields
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_empty_body_returns_all_keys_with_correct_types():
    r = client.post('/post', data=b'')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    required_keys = ('url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin')
    assert set(required_keys).issubset(set(body.keys()))
    assert body['form'] == {}
    assert body['data'] == ''
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['files'] == {}
    assert body['args'] == {}
    assert isinstance(body['url'], str)
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)

test_post_empty_body_returns_all_keys_with_correct_types()

client = app.test_client()

def test_post_url_field_contains_post_path():

tests.name: test_post_headers_field_reflects_sent_custom_header
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: POST to /post with custom header X-Test-Header: sentinel-value
expected: headers field contains X-Test-Header with value sentinel-value
trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: headers field reflects incoming request headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_headers_field_reflects_sent_custom_header():
    r = client.post('/post', headers={'X-Test-Header': 'sentinel-value'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in body['headers'].items()}
    assert 'x-test-header' in headers_lower
    assert headers_lower['x-test-header'] == 'sentinel-value'

test_post_headers_field_reflects_sent_custom_header()
